title: Cold open: the cracked white world
note: Continuous Omni journey takes. Generate only after script approve. Do not wallpaper.

beats.vo_idea: Jupiter fills the sky — giant storm bands
beats.prompt: Orbit the orange sphere robot (single continuous orange body, cream oval eyes, tiny antenna, soft underside glow) approaches Jupiter. Jupiter fills the frame — storm bands clearly readable, cream-orange and white belts. Continuous approach flight. Native soft whoosh SFX only — no speech.

beats.vo_idea: Beside it — cracked white Europa with dark linea
beats.prompt: Orbit flies toward Europa — a bright cracked icy moon. Dark long linea scars cross the white ice shell. Jupiter huge behind. Continuous close approach to the ice. Soft whoosh SFX — no speech.
Orbit skims low over Europa ice — cream eyes reading the dark cracks. Camera pushes along a linea scar implying motion under the frozen shell. Continuous low flight. Soft ice-whoosh SFX — no speech.

beats.vo_idea: Most important ocean is the one we cannot see
beats.prompt: Orbit tips toward a deep ice crack. Camera sense of depth under the frozen lid — dark pressure ocean suggested below translucent/blue ice. Continuous tilt into the unknown. Soft deep ambient SFX — no speech.

beats.vo_idea: Journey through the ice — could life exist under Europa?
beats.prompt: Orbit commits into the crack — antenna glowing — journey downward into Europa's ice shell toward the hidden ocean. Continuous descent into blue-white ice canyon. Soft descent whoosh SFX — no speech.
